detail.subtitle: Customers, suppliers, banks, cash boxes and cost centers. Entries attach them to accounts that require a detail account.
detail.name: Name
detail.deleteMessage: Delete "{name}" (code {code})? If it is used in an entry it cannot be deleted; disable it instead.
detail.limitNote: Only the first {n} are shown. Narrow the search.

errors.code: The code may contain Latin letters, digits and . _ - only (1 to 30).
errors.nameLong: The name is at most 150 characters.

fiscal.subtitle: Every journal entry belongs to a fiscal year.
fiscal.title: Title
fiscal.datesLockedNote: This fiscal year has entries or is closed: only the title can be changed.
fiscal.closeNote: Closing the year stops posting and changing entries in it. An administrator can reopen it with a reason if needed.

blockers.already_closed: This fiscal year is already closed.
blockers.draft_entries: {n} draft entries must be posted or deleted first.

warnings.earlier_year_open: An earlier fiscal year ("{title}") is still open.
warnings.no_entries: This fiscal year has no entries.

fiscal.reopenWarning: Reopening a closed year is sensitive. It is recorded with your reason and your name.
fiscal.reasonShort: The reason must be at least 10 characters.

errors.titleLong: The title is at most 100 characters.
errors.endAfterStart: The end date must be after the start date.

entries.subtitle: Journal entries. Drafts can be edited and deleted; a posted entry is corrected with a reversal.
entries.yearEndNote: This is a year-end entry and is managed from the fiscal year screen only.
entries.unbalancedDraft: This draft is not balanced (debit and credit differ) and cannot be posted.
entries.postMessage: Posting gives the entry a number and it can no longer be edited or deleted; only a reversal corrects it. Continue?
entries.reverseIntro: A draft entry with debit and credit swapped is created. Review it and post it yourself.
entries.reverseHint: Left empty, the system picks a suitable date. If the period is locked, use a date after the lock.

form.title: New entry
form.editingNote: This draft is updated in place.
form.hint: Only level 3 accounts are listed. Enter in the last line adds a new one with the remaining difference.
form.noOpenYear: There is no open fiscal year. Create one first:
form.dateOutOfYear: The date must be inside the chosen fiscal year.
form.minLines: An entry needs at least two lines.
form.amountOne: Fill in only one of debit or credit.
form.detailRequired: This account needs a detail account.
form.cannotPostUnbalanced: To post, total debit and total credit must be equal.
form.postFailedNote: The draft was saved but not posted: {reason}

locks.subtitle: Close the books for a past period. A soft lock can be changed any time; a hard lock cannot be undone.
locks.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. It is kept in the history.
locks.notFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
locks.effective: Entries dated on or before {date} cannot be posted any more.

soft.name: Soft lock
soft.short: Nobody can post entries dated up to this date. Drafts can still be edited. You can change or remove it at any time.
soft.title: Soft lock
soft.explain: Entries dated on or before the lock date can no longer be posted. It is a reminder-strength lock: it can be moved or removed with a reason.
soft.sameDate: This is already the soft lock date.

hard.name: Hard lock
hard.short: Nothing dated up to this date can be added, changed or deleted by anyone, for good.
hard.title: Hard lock
hard.explain: A hard lock is permanent. The database refuses every change dated on or before the lock date, for every user and every role. It cannot be undone from the program.
hard.mustBeLater: the new date must be later
hard.dateHint: Next you see what the lock will do. Nothing is locked yet.
hard.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Check the numbers above first.
hard.acknowledge: I have read the warnings above and I still want to lock.
hard.phraseNote: Type exactly (Latin letters and the Gregorian date):
hard.ledgerChanged: The books changed after the check. Review the new numbers and confirm again.
hard.tokenExpired: The confirmation expired. Review the check and confirm again.

blockers.not_forward: The books are already hard-locked up to {date}. A new lock must be later.
blockers.draft_entries: {n} draft entries are dated in this period. Post or delete them first.

warnings.year_end_not_posted: These fiscal years have no posted year-end entries: {titles}. After the lock they can never be added.
warnings.lock_inside_year: The lock ends inside fiscal year "{title}", which continues until {end}.

history.title: History
history.empty: No lock has been set yet.

reports.subtitle: Reports of the books. They read posted entries only.
reports.emptyMeansYear: Empty = from the start / to the end of the year
reports.fromAfterTo: The end date is before the start date.
reports.hideZero: Hide accounts without balance or movement
reports.name: Account

trialBalance.name: Trial balance
trialBalance.desc: Opening balance, movement and closing balance of every account. Debits and credits must be equal.

ledger.name: General ledger
ledger.desc: Every line of one account, with a running balance.
ledger.accountHint: A group or general account shows everything under it.
ledger.note: The balance is the running balance: Dr = debit side, Cr = credit side.

journal.name: Journal book
journal.desc: All entries in order of number, with their lines.

incomeStatement.name: Income statement
incomeStatement.desc: Revenues and expenses of a period and the profit or loss.

balanceSheet.name: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.desc: Assets, liabilities and equity on a date.
